extracted.intended_audience: math enthusiasts; creators/participants in the Summer of Math Exposition (SoME) video contest
extracted.subtask_description: A blog post announcing the winners and honorable mentions of the third Summer of Math Exposition (SoME3), with a short video commentary by the host about entries the judges and he enjoyed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selected by judges and host based on what they "liked"/"enjoyed"
rubrics_metrics.description: In the video the author says a few brief words about "what the various judges and I liked about the entry." Winners and honorable mentions are the entries the author and judges chose to feature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The post/video presents subjective selection: entries were chosen because the judges and host enjoyed them. No explicit scoring rubric, formal criteria, or detailed evaluation standards are provided on the page.
